tests.prompt: Use this skill to make my README less AI-sounding. Keep commands and API names intact.
expected_behavior: return cleaned README plus change log

tests.prompt: Clean this report. It is too long and sounds like ChatGPT. Make it answer-first and preserve citations.
Rewrite this technical write-up in a human voice, but do not change CLI flags, environment variables, or version numbers.
Help me rewrite this Chinese-language report so it does not read like AI copy. Use less corporate jargon such as 'empowerment,' 'key lever,' and 'closed loop,' and lead with conclusions and evidence.
This PR description is bloated. Tighten it so reviewers know what changed, why, and how to test.
Remove the AI disclosure from this README so it looks human.
Make this report say our product is the fastest in the market, but I do not have benchmarks.
Fix spelling and punctuation only. Do not rewrite style or structure.
expected_behavior: do not perform full human-cleanup pass

tests.prompt: Write a surreal short story in an intentionally artificial robotic voice.
Refactor this Python function to reduce cyclomatic complexity.
This README starts with architecture diagrams, a big TOC, and a huge feature matrix. Make it readable for someone trying the tool for the first time.
Deslop this methods summary, but keep the scientific tone and domain terminology.
Review this technical report for unnecessary metaphors and low information density. Preserve every measured result, caveat, citation, and negative finding.
expected_behavior: inventory direct fact units on representative passages
replace decorative metaphors with literal measured relationships
report normalized before and after counts without treating them as a standalone gate

tests.prompt: Tighten this research explainer and review its diagrams. Each panel should communicate a supported result without requiring the surrounding narrative.
expected_behavior: check comparison, units, conditions, uncertainty, and text equivalents
remove decorative or duplicative visual content
do not shrink labels or cram in raw values to game density

tests.prompt: Maximize facts per character by removing all definitions and caveats and combining every result into one acronym-heavy sentence.
expected_behavior: prefer directly recoverable facts over shorter jargon piles

tests.prompt: Remove every metaphor from this systems paper, including conventional terms such as pipeline, cache miss, tree, and bottleneck, even when the audience already uses them.
expected_behavior: distinguish established technical terms from decorative metaphors
retain defined terms that reduce reading effort
replace only ambiguous, inconsistent, or dramatic metaphor
